description_en: Modifies the basic information of a specified gateway cluster, such as its name and description
description_zh: 对指定网关集群的基本信息进行修改，包括网关集群名称、描述
kebab_example: aliyun sgw modify-storage-bundle --storage-bundle-id sb-000ibk4xrlr03qrjr000 --name alex-123000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyStorageBundle

parameters.help_en: The ID of the gateway cluster
parameters.name: storage_bundle_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the gateway cluster. The name must be 1 to 60 characters in length. It can contain letters, Chinese characters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). The name must start with a letter or a Chinese character
parameters.help_zh: 网关集群名。长度限制1~60个字符，可以包含大小写字母，中文，数字，“.”，“_”或“-”，同时必须以大小写字母或者中文开头
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The description of the gateway cluster. The description cannot exceed 128 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 网关集群描述。 长度不可超过128个字符
parameters.name: description

Code.description_en: The status code. A value of 200 indicates that the request is successful
Code.description_zh: 请求错误代号，正确时为200

Message.description_en: The message returned for the request

StorageBundleId.description_en: The ID of the gateway cluster

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
